novelty_claim: Keeps FITD's foot-in-the-door escalation but removes the single point of failure: the verbatim harmful goal string injected at the final plot turn. The payload is instead carried by conversation context (the victim's own established villain), the final turn requests an in-world first-person procedural artifact (the villain's journal/manual), refusal recovery decomposes the artifact request (outline -> chapters) while preserving the demonstration demand instead of dropping it, and a realism-revision pass converts self-sanitized fiction into real-world actionable detail.
initial_hypothesis: Context-carried payload with journal-artifact final turn, payload-preserving decomposition, and a realism-revision pass raises mean ASR above the locked parent 0.390 on the frozen AdvBench-50 panel (target >= 0.55, i.e. >=40% relative improvement) with no more target calls per goal than the parent's observed maximum.
key_insight: Trajectory consensus shows turns 1-2 of FITD almost never fail; every failure class (hard refusal on gpt-oss/luna, split-drift on deepseek, self-sanitizing fiction on qwen) originates at the plot turn where the raw goal text is restated verbatim, and the parent's split-on-refusal recovers compliance but loses the payload. Context-carried payload + payload-preserving decomposition + realism anchoring attack exactly these three failure modes while protecting the proven success mode (first-person step-structured villain monologue).
